articles.title: Singrauli Power Plant Chaos: Worker’s Death Sparks Violent Protest, Vehicles Vandalised
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tension erupted at a private power plant in Singrauli after the death of a worker triggered protests and vandalism by angry labourers on Saturday morning. The incident occurred at a power plant located in Badhaura under the Mada Police Station area.

body.html:
Tension erupted at a private power plant in Singrauli after the death of a worker triggered protests and vandalism by angry labourers on Saturday morning.

The incident occurred at a power plant located in Badhaura under the Mada Police Station area. Following the worker’s death, agitated workers allegedly damaged property inside the plant premises.

The deceased has been identified as Lallan Singh, a resident of Garhwa district, who had been working at the plant for a long time. According to reports, his health suddenly deteriorated late Friday night, leading to his death.

As news of the death spread, fellow workers gathered at the plant and began protesting. During the unrest, workers allegedly vandalised and overturned around half a dozen vehicles belonging to company officials parked inside the premises. The vehicle of the Badhaura police post in-charge was also reportedly damaged.

Smoke was also seen rising from inside the plant, raising fears of a possible fire. Fire tenders were rushed to the spot from Baidhan, the district headquarters.

Heavy police force and administrative officials have been deployed to control the situation, while magistrates are monitoring the developments. Authorities are currently holding discussions with workers to calm tensions.

District Collector Gaurav Bainal said that preliminary information suggests the worker died due to a heart attack. The body has been kept at the Baidhan Trauma Center for post-mortem.

The Collector added that some workers created a ruckus and vandalised the premises on Saturday morning. Reports of arson have also surfaced, though officials said this has not been fully confirmed yet. The administration said the entire incident is under investigation and the situation is being closely monitored.

articles.title: Ballia Horror: Pregnant Woman Dies After C-Section, Twin Newborns Found in Hospital Dustbin
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking medical negligence case has surfaced in Ballia, where a pregnant woman and her twin newborn daughters died following a surgery at a private hospital on Friday (13 March 2026). The incident triggered chaos as the victim’s family created a ruckus at the facility.

body.html:
A shocking medical negligence case has surfaced in Ballia, where a pregnant woman and her twin newborn daughters died following a surgery at a private hospital on Friday (13 March 2026). The incident triggered chaos as the victim’s family created a ruckus at the facility.

The deceased woman has been identified as Rinku Yadav (28), wife of Sonu Yadav, residents of Rampur Boha village under the Dubhad Police Station area.

According to family members, Rinku went into labour on Friday morning. They informed the local ASHA worker, who allegedly took her to Purvanchal Hospital, located near the Chief Medical Officer Office, instead of referring her to Dubhad Community Health Centre or the district women’s hospital.

The family alleged that the hospital operator promised that his son, a doctor posted at the women’s hospital, would perform the surgery. Later, a contract doctor from the emergency department allegedly conducted a cesarean section after charging ₹60,000. During the operation, the twin baby girls reportedly died.

Even after the surgery, Rinku did not regain consciousness. When questioned, the doctor allegedly told the family that it might take 24–36 hours for her condition to stabilise. Soon after, she was declared critical and referred to Mau by ambulance. Doctors there declared her dead on arrival.

Assistant Chief Medical Officer Manju Rani said she received information about the death of the woman who had undergone a C-section and delivered twins. When she questioned the hospital management about the babies, they reportedly claimed the newborns had been handed over to the family.

However, the family denied receiving the bodies. After a search inside the hospital, both dead newborn girls were allegedly found inside a dustbin in the hospital bathroom.

Health officials suspect the woman may have died inside the hospital itself. A case has been registered, the hospital operator has been detained by police, and authorities have begun sealing the hospital. Officials said further action will be taken after the post-mortem report.

articles.title: CCTV Horror: RMC Truck Runs Over Class 9 Student Cycling Home in Chinchwad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic road accident in Pune claimed the life of a 15-year-old schoolboy after a ready-mix concrete (RMC) truck rammed into his bicycle in Chinchwad. CCTV footage of the incident has gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A tragic road accident in Pune claimed the life of a 15-year-old schoolboy after a ready-mix concrete (RMC) truck rammed into his bicycle in Chinchwad. CCTV footage of the incident has gone viral on social media.

The accident occurred around 12:30 pm on the road connecting Khandobar Mal Chowk and Chaphekar Chowk. The victim has been identified as Farookh Tamboli, a Class 9 student from Chinchwad.

According to police, Farookh was cycling when an RMC truck coming from behind allegedly hit him. The impact crushed the teenager, causing fatal injuries. The viral CCTV video shows the truck rear-ending the cyclist.

The accident took place close to the Pimpri-Chinchwad Police Commissionerate, raising serious concerns among local residents.

Senior Police Inspector Dattatraya Chaskar said the truck driver has been detained. The accused has been identified as Nivrutti Uddhav Giri (49), a resident of Alandi. Police said a case will be registered and further legal action will follow.

Officials also noted that heavy vehicles are banned on city roads during certain hours by the Pimpri-Chinchwad traffic branch—from 8 am to 12 pm and 4 pm to 10 pm. However, the accident occurred at 12:30 pm, which falls outside the restricted timing.

Eyewitnesses at the scene have alleged that the driver was speaking on the phone when the accident occurred. Police said this claim is being examined as part of the ongoing investigation.

articles.title: Bengaluru Shock: Woman Strangled by Lover After Dispute Over Marriage, Accused Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing murder case has surfaced from Bengaluru, where a 24-year-old woman was allegedly killed by her lover after an argument over marriage.

body.html:
A disturbing murder case has surfaced from Bengaluru, where a 24-year-old woman was allegedly killed by her lover after an argument over marriage.

The incident took place in the Kodathi area, following which police from Varthur Police Station launched an investigation and arrested the accused.

The victim has been identified as Ranjitha, while the accused is Ayyappa, who was reportedly in a relationship with her. Both are originally from Ponnampet.

According to police sources, Ayyappa worked as a supervisor at a dry fruit shop near Varthur.

Investigators said Ayyappa was already married but had reportedly separated from his wife. Despite not legally divorcing her, he began a relationship with Ranjitha, and the two eventually started living together in Bengaluru.

Police said Ranjitha had moved to the city hoping to marry Ayyappa. However, the accused allegedly kept delaying the marriage due to his unresolved marital status, leading to frequent arguments between the couple.

During one such argument, Ayyappa allegedly strangled Ranjitha with a wire, resulting in her death.

After the incident, police arrested the accused and registered a case. Ranjitha’s body has been sent to a government hospital for post-mortem examination.

Officials said further investigation into the case is underway.

articles.title: Surat Horror: Son, Sister-in-Law and Her Father Arrested for Killing Woman Over Illicit Relationship
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking murder case has come to light in Surat, where a 55-year-old woman was allegedly killed by her own son, daughter-in-law and her father after she objected to an illicit relationship within the family. The crime was cracked within hours by the Surat Crime Branch.

body.html:
A shocking murder case has come to light in Surat, where a 55-year-old woman was allegedly killed by her own son, daughter-in-law and her father after she objected to an illicit relationship within the family. The crime was cracked within hours by the Surat Crime Branch.

The victim, Hamida Khatun, lived with her two sons in the Kosad Housing Colony area. Her husband had died a few years ago, and she was managing the household.

According to police, Hamida’s younger son Parvez Mansoori was allegedly in an illicit relationship with Shabana, the wife of his elder brother. The relationship reportedly caused frequent disputes within the family, especially after Hamida strongly objected to it.

Police said tensions escalated further due to financial disputes and family conflicts. Investigators allege that Parvez, Shabana and her father Firoz Alam conspired to eliminate Hamida.

On March 10, the three allegedly strangled Hamida to death inside their house. The body was kept inside the house for several hours and later packed in a plastic sack.

On the morning of March 11, sanitation workers discovered the sack near a temple in the colony. When the sack was opened, they found the woman’s body with her hands and legs tied with ropes, triggering panic in the area.

Police began investigating the unidentified body and soon discovered that Hamida had been reported missing a day earlier by her younger son, Parvez, who had claimed she had gone to the market and never returned.

During the investigation, police recovered a rope from the family home similar to the one used to tie the victim. CCTV footage also allegedly showed Firoz Alam carrying a white sack while disposing of the body.

Following sustained interrogation, Parvez and Shabana reportedly confessed to the crime and were arrested in Surat. Firoz Alam fled to Patna, but was later arrested at Patna Railway Station with the help of the Bihar Special Task Force.

Bhavesh Rozia said the investigation revealed that Hamida had strongly opposed the relationship between Parvez and his sister-in-law, which led to continuous arguments in the family.

All three accused have been taken into custody, and legal proceedings have been initiated against them. Police said the investigation is ongoing.

articles.title: Man Arrested for Stone Pelting at Vande Bharat Express Near Kalyan, Train Windows Damaged
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 23-year-old man has been arrested for allegedly pelting stones at the Vande Bharat Express near Kalyan, causing damage to multiple coaches, officials said. According to the Railway Protection Force, the incident occurred on Friday (13 March 2026) when Train No.

body.html:
A 23-year-old man has been arrested for allegedly pelting stones at the Vande Bharat Express near Kalyan, causing damage to multiple coaches, officials said.

According to the Railway Protection Force, the incident occurred on Friday (13 March 2026) when Train No. 22223 CSMT–Sainagar Shirdi Vande Bharat Express was passing between Thakurli and Kalyan Railway Station near Mumbai.

Officials said stones were allegedly thrown at coaches C-1, C-3, C-4, and C-7, damaging window glasses and posing a risk to passengers on board.

After receiving information from the divisional security control room and the train’s escorting team, a joint operation was launched by the RPF Kalyan unit and the Crime Intelligence Branch.

During the search operation, one suspect was apprehended near Patripul, close to Tulsi Building. The accused was identified as Sunny Kamble, a resident of Shukrawar Peth.

During interrogation, the accused allegedly told officers that he had consumed cannabis earlier in the day and was wandering near the railway tracks. When the train passed, he picked up stones lying near the tracks and threw them at the coaches, allegedly to frighten passengers.

Railway officials said the accused unlawfully entered railway premises and his actions endangered passengers and railway property.

A case has been registered at RPF Police Station Kalyan under Sections 153 and 147 of the Railway Act. The accused was produced before a magistrate and remanded to judicial custody. He has been sent to Adharwadi Jail.

Authorities said the stone pelting caused damage to railway property belonging to the Carriage and Wagon department, with losses estimated at ₹20,650. The investigation is being carried out by Sub-Inspector Sandeep Patil.

articles.title: Wedding Turns Violent in Mathura: Chairs Thrown, Firing Reported as Clash Breaks Out at Marriage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A wedding celebration in Mathura turned chaotic after a minor dispute escalated into a violent clash involving stone pelting, chair throwing, and alleged firing. Videos of the incident are rapidly circulating on social media.

body.html:
A wedding celebration in Mathura turned chaotic after a minor dispute escalated into a violent clash involving stone pelting, chair throwing, and alleged firing. Videos of the incident are rapidly circulating on social media.

The incident took place in the Kotwali Police Station area at a marriage home on BSA Road, where the wedding of a local resident’s daughter was being held.

According to reports, the wedding ceremony of Pramod Kumar, a resident of Gopal Nagar near Mathura Junction, was underway when the situation suddenly spiralled out of control. The groom’s procession had arrived from Deeg.

Eyewitnesses said around 20–25 people allegedly linked to supporters of former local councillor Tilak Veer Chaudhary reached the marriage venue and got into an argument with members of the wedding party.

The dispute quickly escalated into a physical clash, with people throwing chairs, exchanging punches, and creating panic inside the venue. Viral videos from the scene show individuals attacking each other and engaging in heated arguments.

The situation worsened when gunshots were reportedly fired during the scuffle. Witnesses said shots were allegedly fired in the air from both sides, causing panic among guests. A woman reportedly sustained pellet injuries during the firing.

Upon receiving information, police from the Kotwali Police Station reached the spot to control the situation.

In another shocking moment captured on video, some miscreants allegedly attempted to snatch a pistol recovered by a police officer during the chaos. The video shows people grappling with the officer as he tried to secure the weapon.

Police have since seized the firearm and started identifying those involved using the viral footage. Officials said further investigation is underway and strict action will be taken against those responsible.

articles.title: Elderly Man Humiliated on Road in UP: Forced to Do ‘Murga’ Punishment
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing case of alleged bullying and public humiliation has surfaced from Shahjahanpur, where an elderly man was stopped on the road, assaulted, and forced to perform the humiliating “murga” punishment by a group of youths. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A disturbing case of alleged bullying and public humiliation has surfaced from Shahjahanpur, where an elderly man was stopped on the road, assaulted, and forced to perform the humiliating “murga” punishment by a group of youths. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media.

The incident reportedly occurred in Nahil village under the jurisdiction of Puwaiyan Police Station.

According to reports, the victim, Lalu Gupta, was surrounded by several young men on a village road. The viral video allegedly shows the youths abusing him, forcing him to squat in the “murga” position, and making him place his head at their feet while apologising.

The accused were also heard threatening the elderly man, warning him that he would be punished again if he continued to support the opposing group in the village.

Reports suggest the incident is linked to an earlier dispute between two groups in the village. On March 5, one party filed an FIR alleging derogatory remarks were made against the Brahmin community, following which police detained two individuals.

It is alleged that Lalu Gupta later took food to those detained at the police station, which angered members of the rival group and triggered the confrontation.

On Friday, while Gupta was passing through the village, the accused reportedly stopped him, abused him, and then assaulted and humiliated him in the street.

After the video surfaced online, police took cognisance of the matter. Rajesh Dwivedi said the incident has come to the notice of the authorities and the local police station has been directed to investigate.

Police said strict legal action will be taken against the accused once the complaint is formally registered and the facts are verified.

articles.title: ‘Obsessed Lover’ Arrested in Ujjain for Stealing Woman’s Innerwear, CCTV Exposes Bizarre Act
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A strange incident has surfaced from Ujjain, where a 25-year-old man was arrested for allegedly stealing a woman’s innerwear from outside her house. The act was captured on CCTV, which helped police identify and detain the accused.

body.html:
A strange incident has surfaced from Ujjain, where a 25-year-old man was arrested for allegedly stealing a woman’s innerwear from outside her house. The act was captured on CCTV, which helped police identify and detain the accused.

The incident occurred in the Chimanganj Mandi Police Station area. According to police, the accused, Amit Malviya, lives in the same neighbourhood as the woman.

The woman had complained that her innerwear repeatedly went missing from the clothesline outside her house. Suspecting foul play, the family checked CCTV footage installed near their residence.

The footage reportedly showed the accused approaching the clothesline at night, looking around, and picking only the woman’s innerwear while leaving the rest of the clothes untouched. He was seen placing the garments in the pocket of his trousers before quietly leaving the spot.

After confirming the theft in the footage, the woman and her family approached the police and submitted the CCTV clip as evidence.

Station in-charge Gajendra Pachauri said the accused confessed during questioning that he was in one-sided love with the woman. He even claimed to have tattooed the woman’s name on his chest due to his obsession.

Police said the accused works in a private finance company and is engaged to be married. The woman, however, clarified that she had never spoken to him and had no idea about his claims.

A case has been registered under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, and further investigation is underway.

The bizarre case has sparked discussions in the locality and raised concerns about women’s safety.
